title: Reconcile P8 fixture's expectedCapabilityStatus.capabilityId with the real packet capabilityId
description: packages/core/test/diagnostics/probes/p08Ammunition.ts declares expectedCapabilityStatus.capabilityId: 'magic-item-single-use-spend', but the real packet (packages/core/src/discovery/packet.ts, preflightOperation()) reports capabilityId: contract.operationId = 'assertMagicItemOperationReady' (MAGIC_ITEM_OPERATION_READINESS_CAPABILITY). packet.ts's own doc comment explains why 'magic-item-single-use-spend' was rejected as a capability name (an earlier revision relabelled a green single-use economy as an execution-shaped capability no contract backs). expectedCapabilityStatus is descriptive-only today: fixtureContract.ts shape-validates it but nothing cross-checks it against the real packet output, so this mismatch causes no test failure. Found while repairing eshyra-o9bd.19.12.9 (F1: preflight declared operations instead of a future model tool choice); out of that bead's scope. Either correct the fixture annotation to 'assertMagicItemOperationReady', or if a future workstream wires expectedCapabilityStatus into a real cross-check against the packet, resolve the naming there.
notes: Discovered during eshyra-o9bd.19.12.9 (commit 9d37624). Not a defect in current behavior -- the field is unverified today.
close_reason: Resolved inside PR #543 (round-3 repair, merged d889116): p08Ammunition.ts now quotes the real MAGIC_ITEM_OPERATION_READINESS_CAPABILITY (capabilityId assertMagicItemOperationReady) and E8 structurally compares the WHOLE expectation against the contract the packet built, so the annotation is cross-checked rather than descriptive-only.
